title: Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite Pod Vape Kit
description: The Uwell Caliburn G5 Lite redefines the expectations for a compact pod system, delivering battery life that rivals significantly larger devices. Encased in a modern, dual-layer chassis with a translucent optical finish, the G5 Lite is powered by a massive 1600mAh internal battery. This substantial capacity increase allows for extended vaping sessions, potentially offering up to several days of usage for the average vaper on a single charge. Under the hood, the device is driven by Uwell’s intelligent chipset, which provides a maximum power output of 35W. It utilizes a Smart Mode to automatically detect the installed pod resistance—whether it’s the new GPP cartridges or the existing Caliburn G3 pods—and optimizes the wattage for the best performance. This ensures you get the perfect balance of vapour and flavour without the need for manual adjustment. The kit introduces Uwell's PRO-FOCS 4.0 Flavour Technology, a proprietary system that restores e-liquid flavour profiles with exceptional accuracy and extends coil lifespan by up to 35%. The device features a refined Dual Airflow System, allowing you to switch between a tight Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw and a looser Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) inhale simply by rotating the pod. With a 360° Clear View window for monitoring e-liquid levels and a 4-Bar Gradient LED indicator to display battery status, the Caliburn G5 Lite combines high-performance specs with everyday practicality. Please Note: This kit does not come with a USB-C charging cable. We Recommend using the following E-Liquid with these pods: 0.6ohm - Use Nic salt or 50/50 (freebase) E-Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with vape liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
